posts.title: WordPress Ecosystem Vulnerability Statistics 2026: What 23,000 Security Reports Show
posts.description: I analysed all 23,434 vulnerabilities published in the WordPress ecosystem since January 2025: how many there were, what kinds of bugs they are, who can use them and how many get fixed. I also compare WordPress with other platforms and cover how to protect your site.

posts.title: AI Has an XY Problem
posts.description: The XY problem used to give itself away, one follow-up question at a time. Now AI answers every one of them, and people turn up nine steps down the wrong path with code that almost works.

posts.title: This Fence Has No Farmer
posts.description: Every developer inherits code nobody can explain. The old assumption, that someone had a reason for it, is getting harder to trust. Pondering Chesterton's Fence and AI code.
